run_fairchem_cli: run the fairchem CLI with a YAML config file using the main entry point
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load a Hydra configuration from a YAML file with override arguments and canonicalize it
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
launch_slurm_job: launch a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with optional Ray support via the CLI
launch_local_job: launch a fairchem job locally with optional Ray cluster or torch elastic mode via the CLI
